correctness.rationale: The exact probability-normalized degree-three reproducing kernel has diagonal d(d-1)(d+4)/6 and shared-root value (m-1)(m+3)(m-11)/48. On type-A positive roots the Gram is (k-2a)I+a B^*B. The identity BB^*=mI-J proves that the cut and cycle orthogonal projector factors have the two stated strictly positive eigenvalues. Moore--Penrose inversion gives every complex edge datum and the minimum-L2-norm formula, and their ratio equals 1 only when m=11. A standalone exact checker passed 26775 symbolic and rational assertions including direct Gram entries and reconstruction. Finite tests are corroboration, not a substitute for the proof.

The complete spectral decomposition gives all-data solvability, an explicit minimum-energy right inverse and exact noise amplification for every integer size; the 55-vector m=11 orthogonality is the sole zero-distortion point in an infinite family. This is structural and reproducible information for natural sampling designs, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a mere finite computation.
